name: Ω Human Agency Fabric
purpose: Create a privacy-preserving life graph in which a person can express goals, ideas, preferences, boundaries, relationships, projects, skills, credentials, services and approved device/robot interactions without surrendering agency to the platform or its AI.

safetyClasses.MEDIUM: Action with meaningful user or account impact requiring explicit authorization.
safetyClasses.HIGH: Financial, identity, legal, health, security, physical-world or irreversible action requiring strong authorization and human review.
safetyClasses.CRITICAL: Potential physical harm, major financial loss, legal commitment, privileged administration or safety-critical robotics action. Human approval and domain-specific controls are mandatory.

hardRules: Never create a psychological diagnosis from preferences or behavior.
Never infer sensitive traits when a user-authored declaration is sufficient.
Never use personality, horoscope or behavioral signals as hidden eligibility criteria for financial, employment, housing, health or legal decisions.
Never convert an AI recommendation into user intent without confirmation when the action has material consequences.
Never execute a physical-world command without an authorized device/robot capability, safety state, command policy and observable result.
Never expose private life-graph data to an agent unless the requested scope is authorized.
Every material AI action must be attributable to an agent identity, policy, input scope and outcome.
Every user idea remains user-owned input unless a separate lawful agreement states otherwise.
